visualCharacteristics.structure: h2 heading + grid of linked paint swatches (name + code on the swatch, readable text via color theme)
visualCharacteristics.layout: 3-up mobile / 4-up tablet / 7-up desktop square swatch grid; plain link fallback for links not in code|name|hex form

contentPattern: Row 1: [h2 heading]. Row 2: [ul > li > a href=/colors/color-detail/{code} text="CODE|Name|HEX"]. A row with a non-color link (e.g. the legacy data-feed URL) renders as a plain link. Section metadata id (e.g. trends) becomes the section id.
